gloss: crucial moment to persevere; time to hang in there

definitions.gloss: crucial moment to persevere; time to stand firm
definitions.explanation: A critical point where one must endure hardship or exert maximum effort. Implies that giving up now would waste previous effort, so one should push through.

examples.japanese: ここが{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころだ。
examples.english: This is the moment to hang in there.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{前|まえ}の{一週間|いっしゅうかん}が{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころだ。
examples.english: The week before the exam is the crucial time to push through.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}が{落|お}ちている{今|いま}こそ{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころだと{社長|しゃちょう}は{社員|しゃいん}に{語|かた}った。
examples.english: The president told the employees that now, when sales are declining, is the time to persevere.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with ここが or {今|いま}が to mark the present moment as the critical time to endure. Common in sports, business, and exam preparation contexts. Carries a strong motivational tone.

FORMATION:
{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}る (to brace oneself, to stand firm) + どころ (place/time for doing something).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ここが{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころ (this is the time to stand firm)
- {今|いま}が{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころ (now is the time to persevere)
- {正念場|しょうねんば}と{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころ (critical juncture and time to endure)
